svg.title: paceline in its different states
svg.desc: Fresh day, Working through the day, Session time, Most of the budget used, Over budget, Over budget by a whole day, Week forecast to run out, Session running low, The last day, Agent job in progress, An /orc-loop run and its review batch, Verbose, counting down, fast mode, Both limits, as the Go line.
svg.text: The day starts with its budget, 14 points of the week; none of it is spent.
Spent points drain the bar; green while there is room.
How long this session has been running; it counts up as you work.
Yellow past 70% of the budget, red past 85%.
The overage turns red, and tomorrow's budget shrinks to match.
Over budget by a whole day
Twice the budget fills the bar with red, and tomorrow gets half a day.
At the current pace the week ends before it resets.
With the session segment on, its reset time becomes out ~10:15am, in red.
Whatever the week has left is today's budget; with plenty left, go hard if you need to.
A long agent job, such as a loop, shows its progress; the context warning appears at 70%.
An /orc-loop run and its review batch
orc-pack's /orc-loop: one cell per issue, and where the dev -> main batch stands in review.
verbose and countDirection in paceline.json; fast mode from settings.
Both limits, as the Go line
"limits": "both" skips the forecast and shows the session too.
